--- a/src/middleware/auth.py
+++ b/src/middleware/auth.py
@@ -10,7 +10,9 @@ class AuthHandler:
-    def check(self, token):
-        return self.validator.valid(token)
+    def check(self, token, *, rotate=False):
+        if rotate:
+            token = self.validator.rotate(token)
+        return self.validator.valid(token)
